verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy axis for an IAM server that stores user data, but the evidence pack never documents retention settings, user or account deletion, or data purge. The closest items are adjacent features: profile and session management in the account console, admin user and session management, and token revocation. None of these is control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
